messages:
sam: Quick sync — i'm proposing we extend the swapback window after an active/active failover from 30s -> 120s. Observed KV lease propagation + KMS unseal in eu-west can add ~40–60s. Short window causes noisy flipflop and writes routed to wrong region. thoughts?

maria: 30s feels tight. longer window reduces thrash but increases time we serve degraded region. any SLA impact? :thinking_face:

devon: +1 on longer window. two quick concerns: (1) split-brain for tenants with residency=true, (2) cache priming/drain behavior.

raj: FWIW our median cross-region RTT is ~80ms but cold KMS + disk can add seconds. what if we make window adaptive rather than fixed? e.g., TTL = max(30s, 3x p95-probe) per-region.

lina: Important: we cannot auto-swapback writes for EU-residency tenants. Even during the window we must honor residency flag and keep writes local. Read fallback can be looser.

sam: Agreed on residency guardrails. Proposal: adaptive window + residency override. Policy sketch:
```
swapback_ttl = max(global_min, 3 * region_probe.p95, operator_override)
if tenant.residency == true: swapback_mode = HOLD_UNTIL_MANUAL
else: allow_auto_swapback
```

maria: That looks reasonable. For HOLD_UNTIL_MANUAL we need a clear manual playbook and a tiny operator UI action to force-swapback with audit log.

devon: Also need to avoid double-accept on in-flight requests during swapback. Suggest drain window where proxies return 409 with Retry-After instead of silently redirecting.

raj: For adaptive probe: run a background latency sampler from each region to each other region at 10s intervals, maintain EWMA and 95th. Use three-sample smoothing to avoid spikes.

lina: +1 on manual override UI. Also ensure KMS unseal is part of probe health — otherwise we won't detect long tail unseals.

ops-bot: deploy-canary: swapback-window-adaptive feature rolled to canary cluster (canary-3) at 2026-03-21T09:12Z — watch tail latency and error rates.

sam: Thanks @ops-bot. Early canary notes: 12% increase in 99.9p token latency during first 10m (probing noise), but swapback flips are down to 0.

maria: Action items: (1) devon: add Retry-After drain response + docs (owner: devon) (2) raj: implement probe EWMA + p95 exporter (owner: raj) (3) lina: residency UX + audit log design (owner: lina) (4) sam: add policy text to runbook and add operator override endpoint.

devon: I'll add a small config snippet to proxy for Retry-After behavior. sample: `on_swapback_drain: respond_409(duration_seconds)`

raj: I'll wire probe metrics to the routing service and add an alert if p95 > 45s for >2 consecutive probes.

lina: I'll draft the manual override flow and include the compliance checklist for EU tenants.

sam: Let's reconvene after canary 2h mark. If tail latency stabilizes and no SLO regressions, we aim to promote to staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: :eyes: documenting now.

ops-bot: perf-alert: canary-3 99.9p latency spike resolved after 22m, error rate stable.

sam: closing for now — will post follow-up RFC with config knobs and runbook link. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
